description: Land economics and development timelines for data center sites by market. Values reflect realistic market ranges as of 2024-2025. Actual pricing varies by specific site characteristics, power availability, and deal structure. Use for screening only.

metrics_explained.avg_land_price_per_acre_usd: Average price per acre for industrial or data center-suitable land. Millions of USD.
metrics_explained.available_parcel_sizes: Typical range of parcel sizes available for DC development.
metrics_explained.entitlement_months: Typical entitlement and permitting timeline from application to shovel-ready (months).
metrics_explained.brownfield_opportunities: Availability of conversion opportunities (retail, warehouse, legacy office). 1=abundant, 5=limited.

Northern Virginia.notes: Land prices $3M-$8M/acre depending on power status. Greenfield increasingly scarce; moratorium risk in Loudoun.

Dallas-Fort Worth.notes: Texas offers abundant industrial land with favorable entitlement processes.

Silicon Valley.notes: Extremely constrained. Most new DC builds require brownfield redevelopment.

Phoenix.notes: Abundant greenfield in West Valley (Goodyear, Buckeye). Chandler tightening.

Chicago.notes: Suburbs offer greenfield; Elk Grove built out.

Atlanta.notes: Douglas County and Douglasville offer abundant affordable land.

Columbus.notes: New Albany offers 2000+ acre industrial assemblage.

Hillsboro-Portland.notes: Enterprise Zones offer entitlement advantages. UGB constraints limit greenfield.

Reno-Sparks.notes: Tahoe-Reno Industrial Center offers massive assemblages.

Salt Lake City.notes: Eagle Mountain emerging as DC cluster.

Austin-San Antonio.notes: Growing competition from chip fabs and semiconductors.

Kansas City.notes: KC Industrial District offers affordable greenfield.

Nashville.notes: Growing DC activity. Rutherford and Williamson counties active.

Denver.notes: Front Range limited; Aurora and Commerce City primary.

Richmond.notes: Overflow demand from NoVA. Dominion Energy service area.

default_for_non_market.notes: Non-DC market; land economics depend on local conditions.
